name: Arkansas Catering Cabot Arkansas
old_description: Arkansas Full-Service Catering for Corporate Events, Weddings & Private Gatherings
about:
Arkansas Catering operates from Cabot, Arkansas, and was founded in 2003 by Chef Wayne Schilleci. Schilleci built his career owning and operating restaurants across the state before launching the catering business, bringing restaurant-level execution to off-site events.

The company provides full-service catering for corporate functions, weddings, and private gatherings throughout Central Arkansas. Menus span breakfast, hors d'oeuvres, lunch, dinner, and dessert, with a specialty in Cajun-inspired dishes such as shrimp creole, crawfish étouffée, and blackened white fish. The team handles delivery, setup, service, and cleanup, scaling from intimate meals to events serving hundreds of guests without a drop in quality or timing. Private chef-style service is also available, bringing on-site preparation and presentation to homes or corporate venues.

Corporate clients use the service for executive lunches, leadership meetings, grand openings, employee appreciation events, and large conferences or banquets. Wedding clients range from intimate ceremonies to full receptions. Private events include birthdays, anniversaries, baby and bridal showers, holiday parties, and family reunions. The company notes a 5-star reputation across hundreds of events served.

Schilleci started the business to offer "Food with Heart. Service with Standards." — a phrase that reflects his emphasis on generous, flavorful food crafted with care and a calm, professional process from the first quote through final cleanup. His decades of restaurant experience inform every menu, timeline, and service detail.
